parse_text: There are several terms in the tea-language relating to the helm; as, _hear up the helm;_ that is, let the flip my or most large before the wind. _Helm amid fribp_ or _right the helm;_ that is, keep it even with the middle of the hip. _Part, the helm_, put it over the the of field of the hip. _Starkbard the helm_, put it on the right side of the flip.
corrected_text: There are several terms in the sea-language relating to the helm; as, bear up the helm; that is, let the ship go more large before the wind.
